loiGiai: \begin{center} \end{center} Dựng $AH \perp CD, H \in CD$.\\ $[S,CD,B] = \widehat{SHA} = 60^\circ$.\\ $\widehat{ABC}=60^\circ \Rightarrow \Delta ABC; \Delta ACD$ là những tam giác đều.\\ $\displaystyle AH = \frac{SA}{\tan 60^\circ} = 3$.\\ $\displaystyle \Delta AHD \Rightarrow AD = \frac{AH}{\sin 60^\circ} = 2\sqrt{3}$.\\ $\displaystyle V_{S.ABCD} = \frac{1}{3}.S_{ABCD}.SA = \frac{1}{3}.\left(2\sqrt{3}\right)^2.\sin 60^\circ.3\sqrt{3} = 18$.
